VERDICT: LGTM

The change slots `formatMembershipNumber` directly alongside its two siblings `formatDisplayName` and `formatInitials` — all three are read-only, Owner-derived DTO fields computed the same way (a `@Named` `default` method referenced via `qualifiedByName` from `toOwnerDto`). It matches that established pattern exactly: same null-guarding convention, same Javadoc shape including the identical `@Named` note, and the OpenAPI entry mirrors the neighbouring `customerCode` field (title/description/example/`readOnly`). The logic lives in the right unit — a DTO-presentation concern belongs in the mapper, not the service or entity — nothing is duplicated, and OwnerMapper remains a focused collection of mapping/formatting methods rather than drifting into a catch-all. A maintainer would find this entirely natural.
